spec_raw: Checkbox and Switch components don't update their internal state, causing inconsistent behavior. They emit the change event but the value prop doesn't reflect.

spec_refined.title: Checkbox and Switch: fix internal state not updating after change
spec_refined.description: When a user checks/unchecks modus-wc-checkbox or toggles modus-wc-switch, the component emits the inputChange event but its `value` prop (and the reflected attribute) does not update. This causes testing frameworks to see stale state.
acceptance_criteria: Checking a checkbox updates its value prop to true
The inputChange event is emitted with the updated value as payload
The switch value prop updates after toggle
Programmatic assignment of value = true shows checked input
All existing checkbox and switch spec tests pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: The `value` prop must be mutable (has @Prop({ mutable: true })). Check the inputChange handler: it emits but may not update this.value. Both components have the same pattern.
